page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2ne.16xlarge is a dedicated compute and storage instance deployed on the KVM hypervisor. Operating on the x86_64 architecture, the system is powered by 64 dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 vCPUs running at 2.5 GHz. The hardware platform supplies 512.0 GB of system memory, which yields an 8.0 GB RAM allocation per core. No dedicated GPUs or visual acceleration hardware are included in this server configuration.

A key characteristic of the ecs.i2ne server family is its local storage capacity. The configuration bundles 15358 GB of direct-attached local SSD storage, bypassing network-attached block storage protocols to ensure high local disk throughput and low-latency input/output operations. For external connectivity, the server features a baseline network throughput of 20 Gbps. It includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The combination of substantial memory and extensive local solid-state storage makes this instance cost-effective for I/O-heavy operations by avoiding separate networked block storage volume costs and latency penalties. Because the bundled disks are host-local, data safety requires application-level clustering and replication strategies. The resource profile aligns with large-scale distributed databases, transactional processing, Elasticsearch clusters, and big data analytics pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2ne.16xlarge is a dedicated virtual instance designed for data-intensive enterprise workloads. Powered by the x86_64 architecture and running on KVM, it provides 64 dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 vCPUs clocked at 2.5 GHz alongside 512.0 GB of system memory, maintaining an 8.0 GB per-core ratio. The server features 15358 GB of bundled direct-attached local SSD storage, delivering high local disk capacity without external storage network overhead. Network throughput is provisioned with a 20 Gbps baseline, and the server includes no graphics accelerators or bundled public IPv4 addresses. Delivering balanced compute, high memory density, and massive direct-attached solid-state capacity, the ecs.i2ne.16xlarge is built for large distributed databases, high-throughput search indexing, transactional data stores, and big data processing.
